comments.author: @BestHiddenPlaces
comments.text:
In the middle of the Sahara, where a whole year of rain is less than a tenth of an inch, hundreds of camels still come down every day to drink from one black canyon pool, the one a handful of crocodiles call home. 🐪🐊
If you lived in Chad for a week, what would you plan your day around first: the water cart, the rains, or the nearest well?

replies.text: Greetings to Mombasa! 🌊 From the Kenyan coast all the way to the Sahara. Thank you for watching, and if you’ve ever been to Lake Chad or the Sahel, we’d love to hear what struck you most.

replies.text: Hello Nairobi! 🇰🇪 Thanks for joining us from Kenya. Which part of Chad surprised you most: the water carts in N’Djamena or the camels and crocodiles at Guelta d’Archei?
